business strategic orientation, information systems strategic orientation, and strategic alignment have important implications for information systems effectiveness and business performance, and that a holistic, systems approach is more appropriate than a bivariate approach for measuring these concepts.

business strategic orientation, strategic orientation of information systems (IS), and strategic alignment of IS and business have positive impacts on the perceived effectiveness and business performance.
